name: Pathrusites
title: Peoples descended from Mizraim
summary: The Pathrusites were one of the peoples descended from Mizraim (Egypt) in the table of nations. The name is linked to Pathros, Upper (southern) Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the table of nations
keyEvents.description: The Pathrusites are listed among Mizraim's descendants in the genealogy of Ham.
